body: How can we hide the monuments when there is a big red x on the exact spot where they are!? I mined like a ton of obby in volcano to hide the monument and noticed the hologram... annoying

replies.body: Oh, gosh, hiding the obsidian in other obsidians is super annoying in my opinion. Like, the only chance the enemy has to win is if you're not at the monument.
